arguments.text: Stage 2 implementation and fixture report were verified locally. evaluate filters by matching claim, withdrawal, verification policy, and exact canonical JSON equality for each required condition; missing required request keys are sorted; only eligible records supersede sources; canonical values determine agreement/conflict; Boolean false alone maps to unsupported; inputs remain unmodified. report.json equals evaluating every current request against current evidence and policy.

Unresolved limits: the contract does not specify malformed/non-JSON inputs, non-dict requests/policies/records, duplicate or non-string required condition names, non-sortable/missing source IDs, or cyclic/self/duplicate supersession beyond the implemented literal source-ID removal. Canonical JSON intentionally rejects NaN/infinity. Extra non-required record conditions do not affect eligibility because only policy-required conditions are matched.
